result.summary: Replaces the Boost.Test library with a custom in-tree C++ unit test runner and assertion framework implemented in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. The new framework uses expression decomposition to automatically log operand values on failed checks, while retaining backward-compatible BOOST_* macro shims to prevent merge conflicts across open PRs. Boost.Test is removed from depends, Guix, vcpkg, and CMake build recipes.
result.problem: Boost.Test introduces external dependency maintenance overhead in depends and Guix, interferes with tooling like IWYU and clang-tidy, and has required workarounds for library quirks such as undersized signal stacks. Furthermore, its multiple assertion macros inconsistently format failure messages and omit operand values, complicating test debugging.
evidence: Replacing Boost.Test has been a long-standing RFC and issue across #8670, #34666, and related stack work like #36045 ('test: avoid undersized Boost.Test signal stacks').

Author description highlights dependency simplification and tooling friction: 'Replacing Boost.Test as a runner helps us simplify depends and guix as well as use IWYU and clang-tidy within the tests more effectively.'

enables: Subsequent file-by-file migration of unit tests from BOOST_* shims to native TEST_CASE and CHECK macros.

result.scope_notes: A scripted-diff accounts for the vast majority of touched files (150+ test files changing #include directives from Boost.Test headers to test/util/framework.h). Core logic changes are concentrated in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and build system scripts.
result.changed_since_previous: Rebased without fundamental architectural changes; maintains the in-tree runner implementation, scripted test migration, and build system dependency cleanup.
result.card: This PR replaces Boost.Test with an in-tree C++ test runner and assertion framework located in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. Boost.Test introduces build dependency overhead in depends and Guix, creates hurdles for clang-tidy and IWYU tooling, and requires platform-specific signal stack workarounds. Removing Boost's test framework addresses long-standing discussions tracked in #8670 and #34666. Backward-compatible BOOST_* macro shims are retained so existing test files and in-flight pull requests do not suffer merge conflicts. The vast majority of the 167 changed files are mechanical include changes executed by a scripted diff.

risk.why: Defects in the custom test runner could cause test failures to be misreported or tests to silently pass when they should fail.
